Class EmailAddressChanges

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.emaillink.EmailAddressChanges
public class EmailAddressChanges extends Object
Adds an email address to a signed-in identity, or makes one theirs in place of another, only once the person confirms a link or code sent to it. EmailCredentialService.register(Identity, String) attaches an address at once and suits an application vouching for it, such as an invite; this is for a person asking for themselves.

request(UUID, String, UUID) never throws and does not say whether an address is taken, so run it off the request thread and answer the caller the same way whatever it returns. Do not call the confirm methods inside a transaction: a wrong code's attempt must count even though the call fails.

    • EmailAddressChanges

      public EmailAddressChanges(EmailCredentialService credentials, EmailAddressRequestRepository requests, EmailLinkSender sender, EmailLinkSettings settings, String confirmationUrl, Clock clock, WhoEventPublisher eventPublisher)
      Creates the service.
      Parameters:
      credentials - registers and replaces the addresses
      requests - keeps the requests waiting to be confirmed
      sender - sends the confirmation and the notice to a replaced address
      settings - the link lifetime, resend interval, code length, attempts and code secret
      confirmationUrl - the page that receives the confirmation link; the token follows TOKEN_FRAGMENT
      clock - the current time
      eventPublisher - where EmailAddressConfirmationRequested is published

    • request

      public EmailAddressRequestOutcome request(UUID identityId, String address, UUID replaces)
      Asks to add an address to the identity, or with replaces, to make it the identity's in place of that address. Sends the address a link and a code, unless it is not an address, is registered already (to anyone), or a request by this identity or for this address was made within the resend interval. A new request replaces the identity's earlier one. Publishes EmailAddressConfirmationRequested.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity asking; the only one that can confirm
      address - the address as typed
      replaces - the identity's email credential it replaces, or null to add it; the caller checks it is the identity's
      Returns:
      what became of the request

    • confirmToken

      public EmailCredential confirmToken(Identity identity, String token)
      Confirms the identity's request with the token from the confirmation link.
      Parameters:
      identity - the identity signed in; a token works only for the identity that asked
      token - the token from the link
      Returns:
      the identity's credential for the confirmed address
      Throws:
      InvalidEmailAddressConfirmationException - if no live request of the identity matches
      EmailAddressTakenException - if the address was registered since

    • confirmCode

      public EmailCredential confirmCode(Identity identity, String code)
      Confirms the identity's request with the code from the confirmation email. Each try counts against codeMaxAttempts; once they run out, even the right code fails.
      Parameters:
      identity - the identity signed in
      code - the code as typed
      Returns:
      the identity's credential for the confirmed address
      Throws:
      InvalidEmailAddressConfirmationException - if the code is malformed or wrong, or the identity has no live request with attempts left
      EmailAddressTakenException - if the address was registered since
